text: Which file format is used to store called genetic variants (such as SNPs and indels) relative to a reference genome?
explanation: VCF (Variant Call Format) is specifically designed to store variant calls such as SNPs and indels. BED stores generic genomic intervals or regions, GFF3/GTF store gene and feature annotations, and SAM/BAM store aligned sequencing reads -- all real bioinformatics formats, but none designed specifically for variant calls.
